title: Dependency Map (T08)
subtitle: What each initiative needs from another initiative or an external party, by when, and who owns it. Schedule flags are warnings; a dependency that would close a cycle is refused.
cycleField: This link would close a dependency cycle.
cycleNoPath: This dependency would close a cycle. Nothing was saved.

map.title: Dependency map
map.intro: From must deliver before To. Flags compare the predecessor's finish with the needed-by date and the sequence; a missing date is shown as Unknown, never as no conflict.
map.caption: T08 dependency map: dependency, from, to, type, needed by, owner, status and mitigation
map.archiveBody: Archived dependencies leave the map and no longer count in cycle and schedule checks. They are never deleted.

form.fromLabelHint: For example a vendor, a regulator or another programme.

types.title: Dependency types
types.intro: Decision, Tech, Data and Vendor (B0081) and Other are system types and cannot be deleted. Administrators can add, relabel and retire other types.
types.caption: Dependency types
types.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (2 to 48 characters). It cannot be changed later.

problem.dependency__self: An initiative cannot depend on itself.
problem.dependency__unknown_type: This dependency type is unknown or retired. Choose another type.
problem.dependency__to_required: Choose the initiative that needs this dependency.
problem.dependency__managed_by_t08: This dependency links initiatives and is managed in the dependency map.
problem.dependency_type__system_undeletable: A system dependency type cannot be deleted or retired.
problem.dependency_type__duplicate_code: A dependency type with this code already exists.
problem.dependency_type__already_retired: This dependency type is already retired.
problem.dependency_type__code_format: Use lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (2 to 48 characters).
